name: AP Statistics
frameworkVersion: Course and Exam Description effective fall 2026 (revised course; first exam May 2027).

frq.note: Released questions before 2027 were written for the earlier nine-unit course, so some (for example, inference for slopes) fall outside the 2026-27 course.
frq.setsNote: Whole released exams (PDF, College Board). They are not matched to units, and they were written for the earlier course. Scoring guidelines are on the course's past-exam-questions page.

source.title: AP Statistics – AP Central (College Board)
source.note: Unit titles confirmed on AP Central on 2026-10-11. College Board's revisions page says the revised course is effective for 2026-27 (first exam May 2027): the earlier Units 1–8 were consolidated into 5 units and inference for slopes was removed. Topic names are the "topics may include" lists on the AP Students course page (checked 2026-10-11), which are a selection, not the full framework.
